pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:1.2: tena kho pana samayena caṇḍakālī bhikkhunī kismiñcideva adhikaraṇe paccākatā kupitā anattamanā evaṃ vadeti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:1.3: chandagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo dosagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo, mohagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo bhayagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:1.4: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:1.5: “kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā caṇḍakāḷī kismiñcideva adhikaraṇe paccākatā kupitā anattamanā evaṃ vakkhati
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:1.7: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave caṇḍakāḷī bhikkhunī kismiñcideva adhikaraṇe paccākatā kupitā anattamanā evaṃ vadeti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:1.8: chandagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo …pe… bhayagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo”ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:1.11: “kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhave caṇḍakāḷī bhikkhunī kismiñcideva adhikaraṇe paccākatā kupitā anattamanā evaṃ vakkhati:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:1.14: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:1.15.1: “yā pana bhikkhunī kismiñcideva adhikaraṇe paccākatā kupitā anattamanā evaṃ vadeyya:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:1.16: “chandagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo dosagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo mohagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo bhayagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo”ti
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:1.18: māyye kismiñcideva adhikaraṇe paccākatā kupitā anattamanā evaṃ avaca,
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:1.19: chandagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo dosagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo mohagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo bhayagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo”ti
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:1.20: ayyā kho chandāpi gaccheyya dosāpi gaccheyya mohāpi gaccheyya bhayāpi gaccheyyāti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:1.21: evañca sā bhikkhunī bhikkhunīhi vuccamānā tatheva paggaṇheyya, sā bhikkhunī bhikkhunīhi yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbā, tassa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:1.22: yāvatatiyañce samanubhāsiyamānā taṃ paṭinissajjeyya iccetaṃ kusalaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:1.23: no ce paṭinissajjeyya ayampi bhikkhunī yāvatatiyakaṃ dhammaṃ āpannā nissāraṇīyaṃ saṅghādisesanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:2.1.6: adhikaraṇaṃ nāma cattāri adhikaraṇāni: vivādādhikaraṇaṃ anuvādādhikaraṇaṃ āpattādhikaraṇaṃ kiccādhikaraṇaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:2.1.12: chandagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo dosagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo mohagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo bhayagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:2.1.16: aññāhi bhikkhunīhi. yā passanti yā suṇanti tāhi vattabbā,
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:2.1.17: “māyye kismiñcideva adhikaraṇe paccākatā kupitā anattamanā evaṃ avaca,
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:2.1.18: chandagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo …pe… bhayagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo”ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:2.1.19: ayyā kho chandāpi gaccheyya dosāpi gaccheyya mohāpi gaccheyya bhayāpi gaccheyyāti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:2.1.26: “māyye kismiñcideva adhikaraṇe paccākatā kupitā anattamanā evaṃ avaca,
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:2.1.27: chandagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo …pe… bhayagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo”ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:2.1.28: ayyā kho chandāpi gaccheyya …pe… bhayāpi gaccheyyāti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:2.1.36: “suṇātu me ayye saṅgho ayaṃ itthannāmā bhikkhunī kismiñcideva adhikaraṇe paccākatā kupitā anattamanā evaṃ vadeti
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:2.1.37: chandagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo …pe… bhayagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:2.1.39: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ saṅgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuniṃ samanubhāseyya tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:2.1.42: ayaṃ itthannāmā bhikkhunī kismiñcideva adhikaraṇe paccākatā kupitā anattamanā evaṃ vadeti
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:2.1.43: chandagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo …pe… bhayagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyoti
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:2.1.45: saṅgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuniṃ samanubhāsati tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya,
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:2.1.46: yassā ayyāya khamati itthannāmāya bhikkhuniyā samanubhāsanā, tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya. sā tuṇhassa
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:2.1.50: samanubhaṭṭhā saṅghena itthannāmā bhikkhunī tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:2.1.51: khamati saṅghassa tasmā tuṇhī, evametaṃ dhārayāmīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss11:2.1.60: yāva tatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya āpajjati na sahavatthajjhācārā.
